test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**is used to**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence refers to the term "monsoon" in a general sense, meaning the subject is singular.
 
• "Is used to" is the correct phrase to indicate the present usage of the term.
 
• "**Are used to**" is incorrect as "monsoon" is singular, not plural.
 
• Other options ("**is use to**", "**were used to**") are grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Is use to" is incorrect because "use" should be in the past participle form "used".
 
• "Are used to" is incorrect because "monsoon" is singular.
 
• "Were used to" is incorrect because it refers to the past, while the sentence talks about a general fact.
